_comment: Residual worklist from lane DC3-ONLY-PINS (2026-08-21, tracker #94), repo rb3-xenon. Every row's pinned name names a class RB3 retail does not contain (OBJ_CLASSNAME string-absence instrument, 95.70% measured recall on a 256-class control; classes declared only under src/system/{hamobj,flow,gesture}/). The lane NULLED the 69 rows that scored PARTIALLY. These rows were LEFT IN PLACE and are NOT a deletion worklist: the `full` rows are byte-TRUE -- our body reproduces retail's bytes exactly -- so the bytes are real and only the NAME is wrong. Nulling them would destroy real matched bytes; the correct fix is to IDENTIFY the true RB3 symbol and rename (cf. _icf_arbitrary). `zero`/`unpaired` rows carry no credit, so they are harmless but still false. 0x826342f0 is already in _denylist.
_instrument: OBJ_CLASSNAME(X) emits literal "X" via StaticClassName(); X in retail => "X" in orig/45410914/band.exe
